name: Canyon Hotels & Resorts Boracay
detail: It's cost-effective and has everything right in front of you. Even Deniwid Beach Hopping is worth 900 pesos. I'm impressed.

name: Boracay Ocean Club Resort and Spa
detail: Close to the beach, right in front, there are many restaurants nearby so there's no need to go all the way to the mall, surprisingly crowded, all the staff are friendly, breakfast is decent, room conditions are also okay, fridge is cool, the hotel's mart is cheaper than well-known marts. However, if you are sensitive to noise, the full-access room is not recommended.

name: Palette Boracay Isle by The White Beach
detail: The staffs are very friendly and helpful. The AC is great. It's in the main road so easy access to cafeteria, supermarket, karenderia, etc. Just 10-min walk to.the beach. Value for money.

name: Happiness Hostel Boracay
detail: I was pleasantly surprised when I first entered. It was so beautiful. I loved the atmosphere where everyone could talk freely, and I was charmed by all the amenities, including the various tables, the restaurant, rocking chairs, yoga seminar room, and pool. The dormitory room even had lockers, which I was very satisfied with. Personally, I found the air conditioning a bit too cold, so I had to wear extra clothes to sleep, but on the last day, I was able to adjust the air conditioning, which was even better. There were events every evening, but they weren't too loud and seemed cheerful. The East Blahok Beach and Gata Beach were not far from White Beach, so it was nice to walk around. Everything was so great that I will definitely visit again next time.

name: Fairways and Bluewater Boracay
detail: This was the best hotel I've stayed at so far. The room was very spacious and the bed was large. You could see the golf course from the room, and the entrance was so vast that you had to take a bus to get around. The facilities included not only a golf course, but also several pools, a gym, and a private beach. On certain days, there was even a bubble night pool. The staff were very kind and helped me with everything I needed. It’s a bit far from the airport, but the access to tourist spots was very good, making it very convenient. With so many amenities, it's very affordable. I definitely want everyone to stay here.

name: Henann Park Resort
detail: After playing in the sea, it was perfect to rinse off in the outdoor shower next to the first-floor pool area, play a bit in the swimming pool, and then go back to the room to wash up. The photo is from the dinner buffet, which was absolutely excellent. I also applied for unlimited drinks separately, and it seemed like I drank over a bottle of wine by myself. Disadvantage: The water in the shower booth doesn't drain well. Advantage: Everything else is a plus. During breakfast, it’s amazing to mix the spicy soy sauce and fried egg at the pancake corner with rice. There’s also a spicy sauce at the pho corner that, when mixed with the porridge, is incredible.

name: Aqua Boracay
detail: I was worried that I wouldn't be able to enjoy the White Beach during the rainy season, so I moved to Aqua for relaxation, and it turned out to be a great choice. The junior suite room was spacious and clean, and the bathroom was big, which made it comfortable. The bed, in particular, was soft and dry, and I slept well, but the extra bed was too small and uncomfortable compared to its high price. The extra bed seems to need improvement. The pool was also quite cold because of the strong winds, and there were no parasols to block the sun, so it wasn't very comfortable. However, the resort itself is beautiful, and all the staff are friendly. The beach in front of the resort is calmer and cleaner compared to White Beach. There are also more fish than expected, making it good for snorkeling. There are quite a few quaint restaurants nearby, and it's not far from D'Mall, with a shuttle available, so it's convenient in many ways. It was very quiet and not crowded, so I had a good rest.
area: Bulabog Beach,Boracay Island - View on map

name: Henann Lagoon Resort
detail: At first, I was torn between Henann by the beach, but I made the right choice to stay here. The beachside is noisy with parties throughout the night. If you take the hotel's beach towel to the beach, you can use the beach chairs and umbrellas reserved for Henann guests for free. This was very convenient. It's a 10-minute walk to D'Mall and a 5-minute walk to White Sand Beach. No problem at all. If you ask for a float, the staff will inflate it for you, and I gave them a tip. The showers work fine, and if the water is a bit lukewarm, waiting a bit before using it will give you nice hot water. The room service food is delicious. The watermelon juice is excellent. During my stay in Boracay, I researched delicious restaurants and, surprisingly, all of them were run by Henann. However, there were no food poisoning issues, and all the places were exquisite. Finally, it's definitely better to request the transfer from Caticlan Airport through the hotel. They have a dedicated car and boat, and you don't have to wait for other guests to gather, making it very smooth. The staff also carries your suitcase to the hotel. It's slightly more expensive than booking elsewhere, but it is definitely worth it. The staff is properly trained, and they don't ask for tips, but they appreciate it if you give them one. Highly recommended. The room was clean, and it was a wonderful stay. By the way, you can flush toilet paper in the toilet.

name: Henann Crystal Sands Resort
detail: The location was convenient for walking, making it nice to explore the surroundings, and the pool and garden were well-equipped, allowing for a pleasant time внутри the accommodation. The room amenities and services were satisfactory, and the hygiene was well-maintained, providing comfort. The breakfast was acceptable, and the staff's response was friendly, making it an overall satisfying accommodation in terms of price-to-value ratio.
